cards.claim: GDT797 retains a local hybrid working interpretation: the analyst source-family code AQABBA may identify a Jupiter-/Venus facies or register class in the circle, while its okaldy and otaldy surfaces receive separate context-bound bath/treatment-entry and root/drug-article defaults outside the circle. The planetary association depends on the historical transform and remains C0; the opaque source-family alternative survives. This is not a translation of AQABBA as a written word or an export of ok/ot/al/dy meanings.

evidence.quote:
## Result

The best current working theory is:

```text
AQABBA  = possible Jupiter-/Venus facies/register class in the circle [C0]
okaldy  = Bade-/Behandlungseintrag                              [C0]
otaldy  = Wurzel-/Drogenartikel                                 [C0]
```

These are complete-form, context-bound working meanings, not translations of
`ok`, `ot`, `al` or `dy`. The result is a hybrid: one local source-family may
carry status-like graphical material, while the two full strings behave as
different learned content entries.

## Historical layer and renderer repair

GDT796's Picatrix H0/H1 transforms put the two source labels under Jupiter and
Venus. This keeps a Jupiter-/Venus facies class as a source-register C0 rival.
The Chaldean comparator changes the status, and no off-circle paragraph
independently names a planet, decan or benefic quality. Nothing exports into
prose.

Four off-circle occurrences receive the direct contextual C0 displays. The two
circle labels receive a weaker hybrid prediction that prints both the learned
article rival and `AQABBA:Faciesklasse?`; their visible circle context does not
independently prove bath or root/drug content. The GDT734 cache has the old
GDT666 action at f88r.12 and f95v1.4; both are quarantined. That phrase was
composed from analyst components `O_PREP+T_COLD+AL_RAW_I+DY_FINISHED`.
One-word radial and Gabelwurzelstock labels contradict an imperative process
clause. No substring or unseen occurrence inherits either new display.

scope.limits: Circle status and off-circle entry domains are separate claims; no planet is independently named by the off-circle paragraphs.

comparison.reason: The prior GDT796 card states generic learned-entry plus local graphical/status architecture; AQABAC cards concern another source family. Existing okaldy/otaldy cards supply individual domain defaults. None states this AQABBA Jupiter/Venus circle-class hypothesis and its hybrid scope. Root read their complete cases; this is recovery of a historical specialization, not a new discovery.

cards.claim: For its twelve observed all-l complete-context brackets, GDT803 proposes quality/condition field + l-carrier/entry form + value/state/result field. It retains descriptive quality/state + lemma/material + grade/state and prescriptive condition + ingredient/preparation + result/closure as alternatives, alongside an equally live opaque three-field-address model. The roles are inherited analyst labels; none of the twelve brackets is a licensed GDT744 microfield, and no final-l morpheme or plaintext is established.

evidence.quote:
Most importantly, the two groups form **12 exact three-token
brackets on 11 physical folios and 11
different target stems**. Every middle target ends in `l`:

```text
qokeey  chal    chedy
qokeedy sail    chedy
qokedy  otal    chedy
qokain  cheol   daiin
qokedy  otal    shedy
```

The first useful renderer hypothesis from the chain is:

```text
QUALITY/CONDITION FIELD + l-CARRIER/ENTRY FORM + VALUE/STATE/RESULT FIELD
```

The equally live null is an opaque three-field address. The English role names
are analyst labels, not decoded words.

All seven core forms had pre-existing replaceable quality, state or value
roles before this pass. The broad historical architecture therefore makes two
readings worth carrying:

- descriptive: quality/state + lemma or material carrier + grade/state;
- prescriptive: process condition + ingredient/preparation + result/closure.

Neither is selected as plaintext. None of the twelve double brackets is itself
a licensed GDT744 historical microfield, so an opaque address remains a serious
rival. The construction localizes the middle `...l` wholes as candidate
carriers or entries; it does not make final EVA `l` a morpheme.

scope.unit: complete left/middle/right forms, not free l component
scope.limits: No automatic transfer to individual contexts, complementary m meaning, or independently decoded role labels.

comparison.reason: Root bounded current-claim scan for bracket/three-field/Dreifeld/Dreier/Klammer finds no counterpart to this exact observed construction; broader formulary and material-quality arrangements have different units and contracts. Source-path absence alone is not the reason for inclusion.
